reviews.t: Amazing Brush and Improvement Over Pulsonic
reviews.x: First of all let me start off by saying that between two to three years ago I bought the Oral-B Pulsonic from Amazon and have been using it since. I decided recently to have a change because while the Pulsonic has been great, I wanted something more advanced. Also, the Pulsonic did not do a great job at the back of your teeth, so I wanted something that worked 360. I've used the Philips Sonicare brushes for years and decided to try the Oral-B Smart-series after my Sonicare brush malfunctioned.  I thought I had achieved nirvana with the Sonicare series because I constantly received good comments from my dentist during cleanings.  I was wrong.  The Oral-B Smart-series is the best electric toothbrush I've ever used.  I must admit, I believe the sonic cleaning of the Sonicare was superior to the cleaning action of the Smart-series. We were very pleased with it, and when it would no longer hold a charge I automatically looked for a current Oral B model.  I  chose the 4000.  The first shipment came, as always, speedily with Amazo Prime.  Unfortunately, it would not take a charge - not in one hour, not in two hours, not overnight. This toothbrush was an upgrade from a less-expensive Oral-B model that I used for several years before it finally quit on me.  I'm very pleased with this new purchase.  The Oral-B 4000 has much more power than my old toothbrush and gives a deeper clean.  My teeth feel cleaner after using this brush, and though I still need to floss I can tell that this brush is doing a more thorough job of cleaning between my teeth. reviews.t: Great job.  Feels solid and sturdy.  Not too noisy.
reviews.x: Long ago I went with Sonicare at my dentist's suggestion.  Got this Oral B and have to say it is giving my Sonicare a run for the money.  I like the feel of it.  I like the red light that flashes when you are applying too much pressure.  The 30 second alert is similar in both units.  The one thing I really like is that this brush keeps on going once you reach the two minute mark.  The Sonicare stops.  So if I want to spend a few more seconds on a couple of back teeth just to make sure I don't ha

This is, by far, the best toothbrush I have ever used! The vibration is comfortable and massaging, but I also feel like it's really getting the job done. The Deep Clean mode was especially effective at removing my plaque (I checked) and the whitening mode made a noticeable difference even faster than the item description says! Thank you, Oral B, for this fantastic toothbrush. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to improve their oral health :)

If you have sensitive gums, then I recommend the more expensive versions (3000 or higher) since they have sensitivity settings.  If you are sharing the device with others in your household who may not have the same gum sensitivity as yourself, again, I recommend version 3000 or higher since you may not fully understand others' sensitivity levels. reviews.t: Husband loves it, I'm not sure it was worth the extra $$
reviews.x: We are a family of Oral B electronic tooth brush users. I have the 3000 and the kids each have a 1000. For the extra money the only thing I see that is worth any added expense is the carrying case. My husband works out of town and this is great for him to take the brush to/from work each week. Everything else is essentially the same as my 3000. Longer cleaning cycle means it beeps at 45 seconds and not 30. So what? You can figure that out on your own without paying an extra price tag. I say buy

This one is definitely a step up from my cheaper Oral-B electric brush!  I like that it has an adjustable timer so I know how long to brush each "quadrant".  Very helpful.  I also like that it uses the same brush attachments as my now defunct/cheaper Oral-B so that I don't have to go out and buy a different brush attachment.  And I appreciate the travel case on those rare occasions that I am out of town.

reviews.t: Love it more than my oral b e series
reviews.x: This toothbrush is awesome. It's ergonomic, nice feeling in the hand. I like the intensity of the brushing (not TOO much and a red light flashes when it senses you are applying too much pressure). There are three different settings but I haven't really used anything other than the main one. I had some coffee staining on my top 2 front teeth that I thought wouldn't go away and in about 4 days they are significantly faded. The charger holder is a big flimsy but that's not much of a concern for me.

I had been curious about electric toothbrushes for awhile now, but had never purchased one... mostly due to the cost. I simply wasn't sure if it was worth it or not. Well, I got this one and I can definitely tell you that it's worth it. I'm at the point now, where I want to buy one for everyone in my family! reviews.t: Doesn't hold charge as long as claimed
reviews.x: I've had this Oral-B Smartseries 4000 Professional Care electric toothbrush since June, 2012.  The charge has never lasted more than 10-11 uses of two minutes apiece.  The owner's manual claims that a full charge will give you 20 uses of two minutes each use.  That's two times what I actually get.  AND, it takes in excess of 13 hours for the brush to fully charge.  I say 13+ hours because I set it on the charge cord when I get the red low charge light, and the elapsed time I observed that the re

First the good things. It works. In fact, I found the battery life to be outstanding. I took the toothbrush on a 12 day trip and it lasted that long despite only being rated for 10 days. It cleans your teeth pretty well. I also like the pressure indicator that lets you know if you're pushing too hard. Because it's fully functional, I don't feel like I can give it less than 3 stars. reviews.t: Good upgrade over the Oral B 1000 if you need the features
reviews.x: We  have owned different Oral B power toothbrushes over the years with the latest being the 1000.  I have no complaints with the 1000 it works.  When determining if one should purchase the 4000 or the 1000, one needs to look at the additional features the 4000 provides.  If you have sensitive gums then you will need to purchase the 4000, there is a gentle mode.  Additionally, I would not recommend purchasing the floss action heads if you have sensitive gums. While there is an in handle display i

Product is good, easy to use, good quality, compact. The advertised $20 rebate however is a complete scam, i cut out all the UPC codes, including the shipping box one and sent all 5 to Oral B. Got a form letter stating I didn't provide original UPC barcodes. So don't get sucked in to a rebate, they don't honor it.

I saw another review where, out of the box, the unit did not charge at all.  Seems that this has also happened to me. Sounds like Oral B has a serious quality review issue going on. I'm sure the toothbrush works great -- if I could only get it to charge. Unfortunate...

reviews.t: Decent electric toothbrush, perhaps not for those with sensitive teeth
reviews.x: This electric toothbrush worked well, charged easily, didn't take up too much space in the bathroom. Brushing was as effective as with an ordinary toothbrush. The timed beeping system to organize brushing in the four quadrants of the mouth was a nice touch. However, despite the claim that it's "gentle on teeth and gums," I found brushing with it unpleasant. Not outright painful, just weird. reviews.t: It helped me win an argument! Great brush, too!
reviews.x: I love electric toothbrushes and have been using them for years. Ours was getting a little long in the tooth (no pun intended) so we wanted to try this one. Well, I let my husband test it out first since I wanted to test the pressure alarm--I've been telling him forever that he brushes too hard...that you don't need to brush that hard with an electric brush, but he pooh poohed me. Well, this brush confirmed what I was saying. YES! Aside from that, the sensitive cycle was good for my toddler son

Anyone who is serious about their dental hygiene should consider getting one of these.  I won't say it is absolutely necessary to upgrade from the Healthy Clean Precision 1000, which I also own.  This one seems to polish just a bit better than the Precision, which is good, but I thought it might be only due to the head that comes with it being the 'Floss Action' design, which has these little plastic paddles that are supposed to get in between teeth, but also offer a better polishing experience

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the brush's cleaning performance, saying their teeth feel cleaner and smoother after use.
Many reviewers highlight the pressure sensor's red light that flashes when brushing too hard as a valued feature.
Several reviewers describe the 4000 as a worthwhile upgrade over older or cheaper Oral-B models, citing more power and advanced features.
A few reviewers note the brush is a strong alternative to Sonicare, with some switching brands and being impressed.
One reviewer reports receiving two nonworking units, and another complains about a misleading rebate offer.
